purpose: Make the remaining external authorization boundary explicit so no human becomes implicit middleware.
required_capability: Authorized receiver endpoint accepting NAYANET_PROJECT_INTELLIGENCE_BRIDGE_V1 packets
credential_location: GitHub Actions secret or managed runtime secret; never stored in repository and never requested in chat
unblock_trigger: Both authorized secrets are present in the approved execution environment and the receiver endpoint implements the V1 acknowledgement contract.
human_role: Provide or authorize the external capability only; do not manually copy Project Intelligence between systems.
